skill.name: dice-easy-apply
skill.description: Automate Dice.com Easy Apply searches and applications with Puppeteer, remote-role filters, verified document uploads, and conservative submission rules.
skill.summary: Build a guarded Dice Easy Apply workflow with remote filters, resume checks, and application logging.
skill.author: ralyodio

security_audit.summary: Most external-command findings are false positives from Markdown fences, inline code, or JavaScript template literals. Confirmed risks include Dice.com network automation, persistent browser state, shared temp-directory logging, and Chromium launch flags that disable sandboxing. The skill also has contextual privacy risk because it can upload resume documents and submit job applications.

remediation.suggestion: Remove --no-sandbox and --disable-setuid-sandbox. Document a supported sandboxed Chromium setup for local automation.

remediation.issue: Persistent browser profile stores session state
remediation.suggestion: Store the browser profile in a user-owned directory with cleanup instructions and permissions guidance.

remediation.issue: State and logs use a shared temp directory
remediation.suggestion: Use a user-scoped application data directory or require restrictive permissions before writing job history.
Require explicit user confirmation before each application batch and before any resume or cover-letter upload.

content.value_statement: Dice Easy Apply runs can be repetitive and error-prone when resumes, filters, and skip rules are managed manually. This skill provides a guarded workflow for remote searches, verified uploads, dry runs, and concise application reports.
actual_capabilities: Builds remote Dice Easy Apply search URLs with configurable query terms.
Defines Puppeteer launch and dialog handling patterns for Chromium automation.
Checks required resume and cover-letter files before application runs.
Guides resume replacement and optional cover-letter upload inside Dice flows.
Tracks seen, applied, skipped, and already-submitted jobs across reruns.
Produces concise submitted and skipped job summaries with reasons.
limitations: Requires an existing Dice account and a browser profile or manual login.
Does not solve CAPTCHA, MFA, identity verification, or suspicious-login prompts.
Cannot guarantee job eligibility, employer responses, or Dice page stability.
May require manual review for questions, salary fields, relocation, or external ATS pages.

use_cases.title: Run guarded job searches
use_cases.description: Search remote Dice Easy Apply roles with configured titles, skip rules, and duplicate tracking before submitting anything.

use_cases.title: Prepare application batches
use_cases.description: Verify resume and cover-letter files, inspect matching roles, and apply only when required fields are known.

use_cases.title: Test job-board automation
use_cases.description: Use a repeatable Puppeteer workflow to validate browser handling, state files, and application reporting.

prompt_templates.title: Run a dry scan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check before any applications are submitted.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to search Dice remote Easy Apply roles for these terms: [terms]. Keep DRY_RUN enabled and report skipped reasons.

prompt_templates.title: Apply with verified files
prompt_templates.scenario: Submit a small approved batch with known resume files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to apply to at most [number] matching remote Dice roles. Use RESUME_PDF and COVER_PDF that I provide, and stop for unknown questions.

prompt_templates.title: Tune search rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Refine targeting for a specific role family.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to adjust searches for [role family]. Exclude hybrid, onsite, clearance, travel, and roles outside my resume.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a completed run
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review after one or more automation runs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review today's Dice Easy Apply log. Summarize submitted roles, skipped roles, duplicates, and any required manual follow-up.

output_examples.input: Dry-run Dice search for remote React and Node roles.
output_examples.output: A concise report with matching roles, duplicate skips, remote-filter decisions, and no submitted applications.

output_examples.input: Apply to five approved remote AI engineering roles.
output_examples.output: A submission summary listing each title, company, Dice URL, and skipped item with a reason.

output_examples.input: Review the daily state after a rerun.
output_examples.output: A status summary showing already submitted jobs, new submissions, skipped roles, and the state file location.

best_practices: Start with DRY_RUN enabled and review skipped reasons before any submission.
Use a verified resume PDF and confirm the displayed filename before submitting.
Stop for CAPTCHA, MFA, unknown required questions, or identity checks.
anti_patterns: Do not store Dice passwords, cookies, or private credentials in scripts or logs.
Do not submit applications when required answers are unknown or unverifiable.
Do not run broad unattended batches without reviewing role fit and document uploads.

faq.question: Does this skill store credentials?
faq.answer: No. The skill says not to store credentials and prefers manual login through a browser profile.

faq.question: Can it apply to external ATS sites?
faq.answer: Only when the operator explicitly approves. The default workflow uses Dice in-site Easy Apply flows.

faq.question: Does it handle CAPTCHA or MFA?
faq.answer: No. It tells the agent to stop for CAPTCHA, MFA, security checks, and identity verification.

faq.question: What files are needed?
faq.answer: A verified resume PDF is required. A cover-letter PDF is optional when Dice supports it.

faq.question: How does it avoid duplicate applications?
faq.answer: It uses state files to track seen, applied, skipped, and already-submitted jobs across reruns.

faq.question: Is it safe to run unattended?
faq.answer: No. Review matches and confirmations because the workflow can upload personal documents and submit applications.
